calculation.description: Fade each instrument's 5-day return relative to the equal-weight cross-asset 5-day return, normalized by 20-day volatility. Modulate the reversal by the instrument's medium-term 60-day cross-sectional residual trend, using a bounded tanh term to remain interpretable and avoid unbounded leverage. All inputs use observations available at the decision date.

validation.regime_notes: Positive in 2026-27 (+0.063938), 2030-32 (+0.029819), and 2033-34 (+0.016839); weakly negative in 2028-29 (-0.002343). Small 15-asset cross-section warrants conservative interpretation.
